Title: We're looking into a potential problem impacting Microsoft Intune device registrations

User impact: We're checking for potential impact to your users.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Intune and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users may experience failures when registering devices in Microsoft Intune

User impact: Users may experience failures when registering devices in Microsoft Intune.

Current status: Our service monitors have alerted us to a spike in failing registrations for a subset of users in North America. We're analyzing the Microsoft Intune service infrastructure that’s hosting affected users to isolate potential discrepancies or errors causing impact.

Scope of impact: Some users in North America may experience failures when registering devices in Microsoft Intune. This section may be updated as the investigation progresses.

Title: Some users in North America may experience failures when registering devices in Microsoft Intune
